_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve phase_field#4: staggered alternate minimisation converges from a cold start in 5-20 outer iterations, monolithic Newton on the same Variation-based AT2 energy does not converge from a cold start at all. Verified on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.15 (ne=96), VectorH1 order 1 dirichlet='bottom|top', H1 order 1, E=1 nu=0.3 Gc=1e-3 l0=0.1 (2026-08-06): staggered needs 5/8/12 outer iterations at disp 0.01/0.02/0.03 reaching d_max 0.01429550/0.05539218/0.11852371; monolithic Newton at disp=0.03 returns flag -1 after 60 iterations with d_max=2.70677637 while printing 'Warning: Newton might not converge! Error = '; warm-started from the staggered solution the same monolithic solve converges in 2 iterations to d_max=0.11852278. Correction recorded: the 'same solution' half of the claim holds, but from a cold start monolithic is not an alternative - it needs the staggered answer as its initial guess.
